story_type: jet skier overboard in breaking surf at a rock jetty, swimmer carried over the waves to the beach on the hoist
hook: He fell off his jet ski into breaking surf beside a rock jetty.
narration: He fell off his jet ski into breaking surf, right against a rock jetty.
It happened in Manasquan Inlet, New Jersey, in October 2015.
A Coast Guard helicopter crew from Air Station Atlantic City came in over the jetty.
They lowered a rescue swimmer on the hoist cable, down to the rocks.
He got hold of the man, and the cable lifted them both off the jetty.
Under them, wave after wave broke across the inlet.
The pilot cannot see straight down, so the hoist operator leans out the door and talks the helicopter into position.
[short pause] Then the crew carried them on the cable, low over the water, toward the beach.
outcome: The helicopter crew lowered the man onto a nearby beach, where local EMS crews were waiting.
title: Jet skier thrown into surf by a jetty
description:
A Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City helicopter crew hoists a jet skier who fell overboard in Manasquan Inlet, New Jersey, on Oct. 4, 2015, and lowers him to a nearby beach where local EMS was waiting.
